Welcome to the 2026-2027 UNMC Catalog. The catalog provides curricular requirements, course descriptions, policies and current information for the 2026-2027 academic year.
UNMC is home to six colleges: allied health professions, dentistry, medicine, nursing, pharmacy and public health. UNMC’s graduate studies, as part of the university-wide Graduate College, offers research degrees in a spectrum of health and biomedical sciences.
Nationally-ranked programs, award-winning faculty and cutting-edge approaches to learning are just a few reasons why our graduates go on to rewarding careers and continue to shape the future of science, academia and health care.
